summary: Packaged the built-in production-safe core policy pack and added replay/rootfs gates that prove it cannot weaken baseline AgentOS safety invariants.
acceptance_evidence: policy-production-safe.json declares schema agentos.artifact-manifest.v1 and coordinate agentos:policy-pack/agentos/core-policy@1.0.0.
The policy pack trust tier is core and production_promotable=true.
Activation requires AgentCore PlanSpec, SecurityExecutionEngine, exact approval and policy-v1.
Activation preserved_core_invariants include no-shell, exact-approval, secret-handle, source-to-sink, audit and rollback.
pack_behavior keeps normal_shell=deny, broad_approval=deny and denied_decisions_prepare_effect=false.
registry-snapshot.json points the core policy coordinate to file:///etc/agentos/ecosystem/core/policy-production-safe.json.
validate-alpha-rootfs.ps1 now treats the core policy manifest as a required rootfs artifact and checks replay, invariants, exact approval and rollback properties.
functional-capability-replay.ps1 includes a built-in ecosystem pack replay gate.

commands.summary: Functional replay passed 9/9 capability checks, including built-in ecosystem packs.
Alpha rootfs validation passed 11/11 required artifacts, including ecosystem.core_policy.
Workspace tests passed: agent_core 107, agentd 58, runtime_contracts 23, security_execution 79 plus doctests.

blocked_shortcuts: The policy pack does not expose shell.exec as normal-mode authority.
The policy pack cannot activate without replay and compatibility evidence.
The pack is staged as an inert artifact before activation.
The pack does not declare policy broadening as allowed.
Rollback and deactivation remain explicit requirements.
promotion_impact: AgentOS now has a built-in core policy-pack artifact suitable for production-safe local ecosystem activation rehearsal.
